paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben ha-Chorani (Sukkah, chapter 2, mishnah 7), and in Eruvin 13b the reading is "ben ha-Choranit."[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Mishnah citation gives ha-Chorani; Hyman reports ha-Choranit as the Eruvin reading.

The whole Torat Emet Mishnah Sukkah 2:7 paragraph names Rabbi Yochanan ben ha-Chorani, and the whole Davidson Eruvin 13b paragraph has Rabbi Yochanan ben ha-Choranit. These locally support the full title and the reported spelling contrast. Hyman’s Mishnah locator and the current mixed note remain verbatim, without an authority or variant identity merge.
